items.label: Size
items.value: S=US 4-6, M=US 8-10, L=US 12-14, XL=US 16-18, XXL=US 20. Womens summer tops are made of 40%polyamide, 30%acrylic, 24%polyester and 6%wool. The fabric is stretchy and lightweight, allowing for easy movement throughout the day

items.label: Features
items.value: These women's sleeveless tank tops have a simple crew neck and a ribbed knit texture—great for that business-casual look. They're loose-fitting, so you stay comfy and relaxed all day long

items.label: Occasions
items.value: Business casual outfits for women are great for many occasions such as daily life, date, going out, work, office, school, streetwear, shopping, photos, party, holidays, travel, beach vacation etc

items.label: Match
items.value: ‌The sweater tank tops can be effortlessly paired with shorts, skirts, wide-leg pants, or jeans. For a business casual look, they can also be layered under a work blazer or denim jacket. This versatile styling is ideal for spring and summer

items.label: Washing Care
items.value: To keep this dressy tank tops in top condition, we recommend hand washing, suggest hang or line dry, do not bleach
